Part (i) is judged on D* (rows whose assignment-misfit share of variance is ≥ 0.2 on the selecting half of the draws, tested on the other half; noise and baseline parts are reported separately as algebra, not as evidence). With that, criterion (3i) is met (gain 0.125, CI [0.069, 0.318]); the whole acceptance rule is **not supported** (pooled held-out gain 0.034 [−0.285, 0.338]; 3 of 6 mechanisms positive; part (ii) bias 0.008 [−0.327, 0.227]; within-cell excess 0.0007 [−0.0001, 0.0027]). The pre-registered S is noise-dominated, as you said; the noise-adjusted and noise-free variants are exploratory and outside the verdict. The exact-theory bias predictor is in `bias_prediction.csv` (inside the MC interval in 82% of 1283 cells) as the ceiling you asked for. Cluster degeneracy: Louvain at γ = 0.3 gives one cluster on all synthetic graphs; γ = 1, 3 and the planted partition were run. Closing.
